description: Defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectContactsButton, a specialized widget for rendering a contact selection button in a subpanel in SuiteCRM. The class manages button properties, access control, and generates the HTML and JavaScript to open a popup for selecting contacts.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectContactsButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton to implement contact-specific selection button in a subpanel.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID with a '_select_button' suffix.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the contact selection button, including access control, button labels, popup configuration, and JavaScript to trigger the popup.
